title: Carnegie Hall concert and singing Ferris Wheel with Carl Anderson
summary: She recalls the purple gown and leaving the building with Carl Anderson on Ferris Wheel.

blocks.x: You’ll love it. I promise. You did some live concert video performances that Kiyoshi was involved in.
Yes, the Carnegie Hall show, and then one down at the Bottom Line in the Village, East Meets West. [Ken, there may be video of one or both of these shows in the Levy archives]
I don’t remember that one. The Bottom Line? Did I work the Bottom Line?
I think that’s where it was. It was a public show. It was for the video.
Remember anything about the Carnegie Hall gig?
Back to the style. Purple gown. It was gorgeous. Lew Llew [Mathews] was around then too, and Masahiko. I had both of them out there.
That’s right. And Carl Anderson was on [?].
I love Carl Anderson. His voice is like – there would be a time when you couldn’t tell where his stopped and mine started. We sang – we were singing – what was Carl’s big song?
Yes, we sang Ferris Wheel at Carnegie Hall, and Carl and Nancy left the building. I’ve never been that involved in the music. We were not there. We were someplace . . .
On a ferris wheel. It was the first time I can remember really saying, I left the building. I was – we were somewhere else, and it was magnificent. It was wonderful. I loved working with Carl.
